what: Exhaustive maximal-stratum classification of certified regular triangulations of T_8 that are NOT in the arXiv:2602.06888 v3 census.
method: Two samplers.  'walk': scale a census certificate's integer MIN_WEIGHTS by 10^6, add integer noise, take the lower hull -- regular by construction, then re-certified exactly (validate_triangulation + Fraction check_convexity) and skipped if it coincides with a census triangulation.  'rand': gen_fast.random_certified_triangulation (random positive-definite quadratic form plus noise), same exact certification.  Each accepted triangulation then had its ENTIRE affine subspace eta + span{delta_S} swept by compute/zonec.c, which by Haas' criterion is every maximal sign distribution it carries.
conclusion: 4609 certified regular triangulations outside the census, each swept exhaustively over its whole maximal stratum, realize exactly the paper's 38 M-schemes and nothing outside them.  Sample, not enumeration.
